lessons.title: Vacation Types, Historical Sites and Accommodations
lessons.description: All-inclusive resorts, cultural tours, bed and breakfast, climate

questions.rule:
• Vacation Types: Cultural holiday (historic places, museums), Beach/Seaside holiday (sun, sand, sea), Cruise holiday (ship), Winter holiday (skiing), Eco-tourism (nature).
• Accommodation: All-inclusive resort (everything included), Bed and breakfast (B&B), Hostel, Tent/Campground.
• Attractions: Ancient ruins, mosques, palaces, amphitheaters, sandy beaches, natural wonders (waterfalls, fairy chimneys in Cappadocia).
• Weather/Climate: Mild, humid, warm, freezing, rainy.
questions.examTip: LGS reading questions often contrast: 'beach holiday lover' (seaside) vs. 'history buff' (ancient ruins, museums). Read the preferences carefully!

questions.prompt: Cappadocia is famous for its fairy chimneys and hot-air balloon tours. What type of attraction are the fairy chimneys?
questions.explanation: Peri bacaları rüzgar ve sel sularının aşındırmasıyla oluşan bir doğa harikasıdır (natural wonder).

questions.prompt: If a hotel offers 'all-inclusive' service, what does it mean?
options: All meals, drinks and activities are included in the price
Guests must pay for every meal separately
questions.explanation: 'All-inclusive' her şey dahil demektir; yemek, içecek ve konaklama tek ücrete dahildir.

questions.prompt: An amphitheater, a temple and a castle are examples of modern architectural buildings.
questions.explanation: False! Antik tiyatro, tapınak ve kale tarihi yapılardır (historic / ancient structures).

questions.prompt: Efes (Ephesus) is an ancient city in İzmir. Which type of tourists are most likely to visit Ephesus?
options: Tourists interested in history and archaeology
People who want to surf in big waves
questions.explanation: Efes antik kenti tarih ve arkeoloji meraklılarının ziyaret ettiği kültürel bir alandır.

questions.prompt: A place where many tourists visit and enjoy spending time is called a tourist _____.
questions.explanation: Turistik cazibe merkezine 'tourist attraction' veya 'destination' denir.

questions.prompt: Match the destinations with their famous features:

matchingPairs.right: White travertine terraces and thermal pools
Historic monastery built into the cliff
Winter ski resorts and snow sports

questions.prompt: Which question asks about the CLIMATE of a city?
options: What is the weather like in summer?
questions.explanation: 'What is the weather like?' sorusu iklim ve hava durumunu öğrenmek için sorulur.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: Tourism LGS Reading & Chart Exam
lessons.description: LGS MEB travel brochure and vacation preference chart exam

questions.prompt: "I love discovering traditional cultures, trying local cuisine and visiting museums." Where should this person go for vacation?
options: A cultural tour in Historic Istanbul
A desert safari with no cities
A modern cruise ship with no stops
questions.explanation: Tarihi müzeler ve zengin mutfak kültürü için Tarihi İstanbul turu en uygundur.

questions.prompt: A brochure says: 'Affordable Bed & Breakfast near the town center.' What is provided for free with accommodation?
questions.explanation: 'Bed & Breakfast' (B&B) oda ve yalnızca sabah kahvaltısını kapsar.

questions.prompt: The remains of very old buildings from ancient civilizations are called _____.
questions.explanation: Antik uygarlıklardan kalan tarihi kalıntılara 'ruins' (harabeler/kalıntılar) denir.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a traditional Turkish dessert popular among tourists?
A souvenir is something you buy or keep to help you remember a holiday or a special place.
questions.explanation: True! 'Souvenir' tatilden alınan hatıra eşyası / hediyeliktir.

questions.prompt: "The climate in the Mediterranean region is hot and dry in summer, mild and rainy in winter." What is described?
questions.explanation: Akdeniz bölgesinin iklim özellikleri tarif edilmektedir.

questions.prompt: Match the vacation types with tourist activities:

matchingPairs.right: Visiting famous historic monuments and statues
Lying on the beach under the warm sun
Sliding down snowy slopes on mountains
Walking long distances through nature trails

questions.prompt: If you want to travel around the world on a large passenger ship with restaurants and pools, which holiday should you choose?
questions.explanation: Büyük yolcu gemileriyle yapılan lüks deniz seyahatine 'cruise' denir.
